title: MLOps: Keep Your Models Fresh & Reliable

scenes.line1: Why do ML models fail silently?
scenes.say: Ever wonder why machine learning models can work great one day, and quietly fail the next? What keeps them reliable in production?

rows.b: Gather raw info to train on

scenes.say: A machine learning project isn’t done after training. You collect data, train a model, serve it to users, and then—crucially—monitor what happens next.

scenes.label: Automate
scenes.sub: CI/CD pipelines test, train, and deploy models fast
scenes.say: MLOps brings automation. Continuous integration and delivery pipelines test, train, and deploy models so updates are quick and reproducible.

scenes.title: Detecting Data Drift
scenes.say: But here’s the key: monitoring for drift. Automated checks compare new data to training data. If things change, you get an alert and can retrain before users notice problems.

scenes.question: Is monitoring just about accuracy?
scenes.right: No, you must track data and concept drift too
scenes.say: Interview trap: Is monitoring just about accuracy? Nope. You also need to watch for data drift and concept drift, not just performance numbers.
